name: Calendar
description: A month view of your daily notes (YYYY-MM-DD.md) in a side panel: days with a note link to it; the week starts on Sunday or Monday.
author: Lumen

capabilities.reason: Adds the “Calendar of daily notes” command
Shows the month in a side panel
Finds your daily notes by their file names
Remembers the daily-notes folder and the first day of the week
